- LOW_Figaro_SellingThings.json: Figaro Pennygood is the flamboyant "facemaker" who sells cosmetic items and appearance options in Baldur’s Gate; this conversation is used to access his wares and usually includes him thanking the player for intervening. context: Figaro Pennygood is the flamboyant “facemaker” who sells cosmetics and appearance options in Baldur’s Gate; this conversation is the shop dialogue players use to access his wares. The neighborhood is tense from a recent string of murders by the serial killer Dolor, who has threatened or even attempted to kill Figaro — these lines can appear both before and after that attempt. When the player has intervened, Figaro thanks them profusely and often offers a generous discount; his assistant (Devella) remains in the shop while Figaro survives. Nearby NPCs react to the broader unrest (including Father Lorgan’s death), which provides the grim backdrop to these exchanges.
